record.bible_text: And if a soul<WH05315> sin<WH02398><WTH8799>, and hear<WH08085><WTH8804> the voice<WH06963> of swearing<WH0423>, and <FI>is<Fi> a witness<WH05707>, whether<WH0176> he hath seen<WH07200><WTH8804> or known<WH03045><WTH8804> <FI>of it<Fi> ; if he do not utter<WH05046><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> , then he shall bear<WH05375><WTH8804> his iniquity<WH05771>.

And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
